precepts.text: When a rich man speaks all listen, but the poor man is dismissed.
precepts.point: The poor is hated even by his own neighbor, but the rich have many friends. Ecclesiasticus says the same: when the rich man speaks everybody holds their tongue, but when the poor man speaks they ask who is this.
precepts.why:
“The poor is hated even of his own neighbour: but the rich hath many friends.” Ecclesiasticus says the same: “When a rich man speaketh, every man holdeth his tongue, and, look, what he saith, they extol it to the clouds: but if the poor man speak, they say, What fellow is this? and if he stumble, they will help to overthrow him.”

When the rich man speaks everybody holds their tongue and extols what he says, but when the poor man speaks they ask who is this, and if he stumbles they help to overthrow him. The rich has many friends; the poor is dismissed even by his own neighbour.

precepts.text: Riches are good only to the one who can discipline his thoughts, his pockets, and his lusts.
precepts.point: The Most High is the one who brings a man low. Sometimes he withholds money, status, or a job to hinder a man from sinning, the way he removed King Manasseh from his power. Many hurtful lusts come from the love of money, and celebrities get caught up in wickedness because riches in the hand of a man who has sin become a tool for evil. He wants to teach you discipline and contentment first, so that when the money comes it is only a tool to pay your bills and support the truth, not to live in the delicacies of this life.

precepts.why:
“Riches are good unto him that hath no sin, and poverty is evil in the mouth of the ungodly.” Riches are good only to the one who can discipline his thoughts, his pockets and his lusts. Many hurtful lusts come from the love of money, and celebrities get caught up in wickedness because riches in the hand of a man who has sin become a tool for evil.

The Most High wants to teach you discipline and contentment first. Then when the money comes it is only a tool to pay your bills and support the truth, not to live in the delicacies of this life.

The Pride Of Thine Heart Hath Deceived Thee!

points: All flesh consorteth according to kind, and a man will cleave to his like. So if you are around a bad environment and you are comfortable around that environment, if you are around negative people and you are comfortable around negative people, it means you are just like the people you are around. So be mindful, brothers and sisters, in trying to change, you have to separate yourself from negativity, negative people and bad environments. Otherwise you will get caught up.

What fellowship hath the wolf with the lamb? so the sinner with the godly. You are a lamb and you are fellowshipping with wolves. Dudes talking about sticking up people and all type of crazy stuff. Talking about a club, talking about sports and all of this. You are around wolves and you are a sheep. So the sinner with the godly: if you are godly and you are around sinners all the time, guess what is going to happen? That environment is going to rub off on you. The sinner will entice you.

Every beast loveth his like, and every man loveth his neighbour: all flesh consorteth according to kind, and a man will cleave to his like. That is why you see a whole group of bitter brothers clinging together in the back of the room.

points: He that toucheth pitch shall be defiled therewith; and he that hath fellowship with a proud man shall be like unto him. Look at the people the prideful surround themselves with: the bishop says show me your friends and I will tell you who you are.

Video played in class: the attorney general testifying before Congress on the Epstein files, where the department redacted the names of the abusers but released the names of the victims, the worst thing you could do to the survivors. Asked to take responsibility and apologize to the survivors standing behind her, she answered that the questioners should be apologizing to the president. The whole world called it a disgrace, and she was let go. He that hath fellowship with a proud man shall be like unto him.
